summary: Volato Group filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for the sale of 6.5 million shares of Class A common stock at $0.34 per share, raising $2.21 million. This is a routine private placement with registration rights, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing includes customary representations and a nine-month restriction on variable rate transactions. As an ordinary capital raise, it does not qualify as a strategic change or special situation.
